role: Transfer/NN production author; source-bound technical evidence, not independent acceptance or institutional authorization

output_payload.encoding: gzip UTF-8 JSON with per-file lossless UTF-8/base64 contents

preservation.manual_cleanup: No manual deletion or cleanup; native Trash unavailable per root environment report. All original logs, basetemps, packets and single-file mutations retained.
preservation.scope_correction: Earlier transfer-lesson-as-of receipt wording No deletion/no environment deletions describes no manual cleanup. It is not a whole filesystem immutability claim: existing CAS atomic replace and native save/load TemporaryDirectory cleanup still execute normally.
preservation.no_caps: Every deciding child records absent numeric thread caps, actual source-default model/acquisition settings, natural execution. No environment installs/shared venv writes.
preservation.notification_deviation: Original NN baseline characterization was launched before parent heavy-import notification; immediately reported. Subsequent native deciding/negative/removal child launches notified first.

count_semantics: Checks are execution occurrences with repeated controls, not additive unique-test totals; skipped/UNRUN backend cases are not native PASS.

original_criterion.text: **Приёмка:** переданный threshold и trust-filter соблюдаются независимо от маршрута; локальный промах не меняет требования; действительно допустимая transferred-карточка возвращается; несоответствующая не материализуется зря. Проверить source_run_id и политику частичного ответа, не только два численных примера.

**Приёмка:** любое число обычных чтений не повышает доверие; настоящая разрешённая ревалидация создаёт новую версию с новыми основаниями; повторный холодный и тёплый запрос дают одинаковую содержательную степень актуальности. Retention может учитывать популярность, evidence sufficiency — нет. Проверить восстановление после restart и перенос, а не только пару запросов в одной памяти.

intentional_delta: Shared evidence admission still uses explicit as-of/context timestamp. Historical read now records actual wall read time in retention sidecar/returned last_accessed; query as-of never backdates retention. Created/evidence_anchor cannot be future relative to as-of; access never refreshes evidence.

exact_test_scope: 16 new as-of cases +whole test_lessons4 +whole test_lesson_transfer7 =27 of the47-case combined run. Includes local and aggregate historical-read access >=actual before_read and unchanged old evidence anchor. Original14 future/time property controls retained.

compatibility: LessonQuery adds optional serialized as_of defaultNone. TransferContext.timestamp remains transfer caller clock. Conflicts/naive times refuse. No persisted card/index schema or authority-clock subsystem.
limits: Refuses current persisted evidence version later than as-of rather than reconstructing an old version.
